answer: You don't have to start the whole process over. Your offer has expired, so you'll need to request a new one, which you can do at any time. The new amount reflects current market prices and may be higher or lower than your original offer, so the price isn't guaranteed to be the same. Since we can't complete the purchase until your North Carolina duplicate title arrives (usually 4 to 6 weeks), and offers are good for only 5 days or 250 additional miles, you may want to wait until the title arrives before requesting the new offer.
